ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Sunlight is a form of what?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The top of the figure is labeled “Sunlight,” and there are arrows pointing respectively to the “Maize plant” on the left and the “Wheat plant” on the right. Maize and wheat are subsequently also connected to the food production process of chicken and chicken pizza. Reasoning: The figure represents sunlight as an input in the process of plant growth; scientifically, sunlight provides light energy/radiant energy for plants to carry out photosynthesis. Therefore, sunlight is a kind of energy.
